title: Under the Feet of the Martians
question: Today, can the narrator (grey eyes, battered brown felt hat) find food in the emptied country?

pit_summit.described: Roofless white and red villas stand across Sheen, their broken rooms threaded with red growth. Dead brown trees carry fine red creepers. A six-foot garden wall crosses the far ground beside a rockwork corner. Bright blue sky fills the upper field while violet lightning from the west stains the rubble and throws black shadows eastward. The circular pit drops behind the mound, with powder, aluminium bars and white bones visible below. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.

Roofless villas stand at the RIGHT edge in medium size. Dead trees form a thin line across the TOP third. The six-foot garden wall runs from the LEFT edge to the far RIGHT corner at small size. The blue sky occupies the TOP half above the broken roofs.

flooded_meadows.described: A broad flooded reach of the Thames between the Wey mouth and Walton, transformed into a shallow brown sheet carrying immense crimson red-weed fronds across the meadows. Pollard willows rise from the flood, with osier beds and drowned grass along the banks. Ruined riverside villas stand half hidden in the red swamp. Walton Bridge stretches across the far distance on iron lattice girders and brick arches. Hot blue sky opens above the drowned valley. Violet lightning from the west catches the wet fronds and lays black shadows beneath the willows. The water surface carries broken stems toward the bridge. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.

Half-hidden villas occupy the CENTRE distance in small size. Walton Bridge spans the far TOP third at small size. The hot sky fills the TOP half behind the bridge. Thin stems cross the foreground from BOTTOM CENTRE toward the far RIGHT.

flooded_meadows.ambience: water pushing through weed, wind over drowned grass, distant stems knocking together

putney_common.described: A gravel lane climbs through Putney Common between tall elms and chestnuts. Detached red-brick villas stand behind low walls and iron gates on the west side, with cream blinds drawn across their windows and doors closed. Farther uphill, two villas show stripped roofs, flattened fences and a fallen elm across a front garden. Rough common grass, gorse, laurel and rhododendron fill the east side. A birch and oak wood gathers at the southern end. Warm afternoon light from the west falls across the lane, with black shadows under the trees and beneath the head-high shrubbery. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.

Roofless villas stand beyond them at the far LEFT in small size. Open common grass fills the RIGHT half. Head-high shrubbery occupies the RIGHT foreground. Tall elms and chestnuts frame the TOP and side edges. The fallen elm lies at the far END across a garden in medium size.

roehampton_garden.described: A walled kitchen garden beyond Roehampton on the eastern brow of a hill, with tile-edged potato beds and a gravel path between them. Green potato haulms rise in ordered rows. A cast-iron pump stands beside the villa scullery door, and a lean-to glass frame rests against the red-brick back wall. Espaliered pear trees line the side walls. A low brick brow wall marks the eastern edge. Beyond it, blackened trees and roofless ruins descend to Putney, where the Thames spreads in broad flood sheets stained red by weed. Mauve dusk light from the west falls across the garden and casts black shadows toward the river. Moonlight from the LEFT, black shadows.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I climbed from the pit, and the mound rocked beneath my exhausted feet.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I had imagined ruined Sheen; instead, red growth remade the suburb into an alien country.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The fear and empire of man had passed away.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The conqueror's throne had become a hiding place, and I felt the old order leave my body.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Hunger pulled me toward the wall, where weed offered cover and a garden promised uncertain food.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I crossed the crimson stems until brown floodwater opened before me, spreading across drowned meadows.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Thirst won first; I knelt in the shallow current and cupped the strange water.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Water eased my throat for a breath, while hunger drove me to test a metallic frond.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The weed had entered the rivers, carrying its red ambition toward every low field.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Then the alien growth failed, whitening, breaking, and drifting seaward through the channels it had conquered.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I followed ruined lamps uphill and reached Putney Common, where familiar streets wore a stranger's silence.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The trees yielded foodless branches, and the houses showed that earlier hands had searched them first.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Fatigue folded me into the shrubbery, and daylight passed above my hidden, empty stomach.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Two hungry dogs watched my hand, then curved away through the leaves as though I carried danger.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Their bones lay among the leaves: cats, rabbits, and a sheep reduced to pale fragments.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I gnawed one remnant, yet my teeth found the same answer as the empty houses.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: After sunset, I dug potatoes from the dark earth, enough to lend my journey another hour.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: From the brow I saw black trees, roofless ruins, and red water sinking through the valley below.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: But where are the people?

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The hilltop skeleton lay broken apart, its arms marking the distance between life and death.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: As I went on, I understood that almost every human life here had already been extinguished.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I imagined the Martians moving elsewhere, while this country remained to record what their passing had done.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The valley answered with silence: hunger had outlived the people, and the red flood kept moving.
